menu:512200652:1.text: Where on earth did she go?

menu:512400366:2.text: Yesterday feels like a dream... and now it's over...
menu:512400366:2.source_cn: 昨天的一切就像一场梦，现在梦醒了……

menu:14007020:1.text: So this is the proper way to execute this move...

menu:512400366:1.text: My sword is broken... Maybe this is fate telling me to give up.
menu:512400366:1.source_cn: 剑断掉了……或许这就是我的命运吧。

say:1:1736402001:1.text: Greetings, Magister Merlin. I'm searching for a young lady I've met only once.
say:1:1736402001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下。抱歉，让您见笑了。我正在寻找一名只见过一面的少女。
say:1:1736402001:1.male: Greetings, Magister Merlin. I'm searching for a young lady I've met only once.
say:1:1736402001:1.female: Greetings, Magister Merlin. I'm searching for a young lady I've met only once.

say:2:1736402002:1.text: Last night, I had the honor of judging a swordsmanship competition. A contestant named Cinderella absolutely blew me away with her swordplay!
say:2:1736402002:1.source_cn: 昨晚，我受邀担任了一场剑术比赛的评委。那场比赛中有个叫...
say:2:1736402002:1.male: Last night, I had the honor of judging a swordsmanship competition. A contestant named Cinderella absolutely blew me away with her swordplay!
say:2:1736402002:1.female: Last night, I had the honor of judging a swordsmanship competition. A contestant named Cinderella absolutely blew me away with her swordplay!

say:3:1736402003:1.text: Her fighting style was purely practical. Every strike was straight to the point, without a single unnecessary movement!
say:3:1736402003:1.source_cn: 干净利落，没有任何多余的动作，完全是实战派的打法！
say:3:1736402003:1.male: Her fighting style was purely practical. Every strike was straight to the point, without a single unnecessary movement!
say:3:1736402003:1.female: Her fighting style was purely practical. Every strike was straight to the point, without a single unnecessary movement!

say:4:1736402004:1.text: I meant to invite her to join the Royal Guard after the competition, but she bolted like a startled bunny the moment the midnight bell rang.
say:4:1736402004:1.source_cn: 我本想比赛结束后问问她是否考虑加入守备军预备役，可午夜...
say:4:1736402004:1.male: I meant to invite her to join the Royal Guard after the competition, but she bolted like a startled bunny the moment the midnight bell rang.
say:4:1736402004:1.female: I meant to invite her to join the Royal Guard after the competition, but she bolted like a startled bunny the moment the midnight bell rang.

say:5:1736402005:1.text: Such talent shouldn't be wasted. I have to find her! But... no one in the upper district seems to know her.
say:5:1736402005:1.source_cn: 这样的天赋不该被埋没，我一定要找到她！可是……上城区好...
say:5:1736402005:1.male: Such talent shouldn't be wasted. I have to find her! But... no one in the upper district seems to know her.
say:5:1736402005:1.female: Such talent shouldn't be wasted. I have to find her! But... no one in the upper district seems to know her.

say:7:1736402006:1.text: What a coincidence! This must be fate at work!
say:7:1736402006:1.source_cn: 竟然会有这样的缘分吗？我越发觉得这是命运的指引了。
say:7:1736402006:1.male: What a coincidence! This must be fate at work!
say:7:1736402006:1.female: What a coincidence! This must be fate at work!

say:8:1736402007:1.text: Magister Merlin, please show me the way!
say:8:1736402007:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，请您带我找到她！
say:8:1736402007:1.male: Magister Merlin, please show me the way!
say:8:1736402007:1.female: Magister Merlin, please show me the way!

choice:6:1:2.text: I can take you to her!
choice:6:1:2.male: I can take you to her!
choice:6:1:2.female: I can take you to her!

say:1:1736403001:1.text: C-Captain Gwyneth?! What brings you here?
say:1:1736403001:1.source_cn: 格、格温妮丝大人？！您、您怎么会在这里？

say:2:1736403002:1.text: There you are! I must say, your swordsmanship is exceptional. Have you had formal training?
say:2:1736403002:1.source_cn: 我是专门来找你的。你的剑术非常出色，有人教你吗？

say:3:1736403003:1.text: Formal training? No, I just figured it out myself...
say:3:1736403003:1.source_cn: 剑术？都是我自己练的……没有人教我。

say:4:1736403004:1.text: Would you consider joining the Royal Guard reserves?
say:4:1736403004:1.source_cn: 辛德瑞拉，你愿意加入皇家守备军预备役吗？

say:5:1736403005:1.text: You should use your talent to defend those in need.
say:5:1736403005:1.source_cn: 你的才华不应该被埋没，而应该握剑，去保护更多的人！

say:7:1736403007:1.text: You are! I'll train you myself until you become a full-fledged guard!
say:7:1736403007:1.source_cn: 当然可以！只要你愿意，我会亲自教导你，直到你成为一名合...

say:3:1736404002:1.text: So far, so good! I'm still a reserve for now, but Captain Gwyneth lets me observe the drills and learn proper sword techniques!
say:3:1736404002:1.source_cn: 这里太棒了！虽然因为缺乏实战经验的原因，我现在还只是预...
say:3:1736404002:1.male: So far, so good! I'm still a reserve for now, but Captain Gwyneth lets me observe the drills and learn proper sword techniques!
say:3:1736404002:1.female: So far, so good! I'm still a reserve for now, but Captain Gwyneth lets me observe the drills and learn proper sword techniques!

say:4:1736404003:1.text: If I keep working hard, I believe I'll get to fight alongside Captain Gwyneth one day!
say:4:1736404003:1.source_cn: 只要不断地练习，不断地成长，总有一天我能站在格温妮丝大...
say:4:1736404003:1.male: If I keep working hard, I believe I'll get to fight alongside Captain Gwyneth one day!
say:4:1736404003:1.female: If I keep working hard, I believe I'll get to fight alongside Captain Gwyneth one day!

say:5:1736404004:1.text: I hope to become a knight just like her!
say:5:1736404004:1.source_cn: 到那一天，我会像格温妮丝大人一样，成为一名真正的骑士！
say:5:1736404004:1.male: I hope to become a knight just like her!
say:5:1736404004:1.female: I hope to become a knight just like her!

choice:2:1:2.text: How are you finding it here?
choice:2:1:2.male: How are you finding it here?
choice:2:1:2.female: How are you finding it here?

say:1:1736601002:0.text: ... Must I resign myself to fate?

say:0:1736602001:1.text: That young lady seems to be in tears... Did something go wrong?
say:0:1736602001:1.source_cn: 她好像在哭……是遇到什么困难了吗？或许可以去关心一下……
say:0:1736602001:1.male: That young lady seems to be in tears... Did something go wrong?
say:0:1736602001:1.female: That young lady seems to be in tears... Did something go wrong?

say:1:1736603001:1.text: I'm fine. It's just... my sword is broken.
say:1:1736603001:1.source_cn: 我没事。我只是有些……我的剑断了。
say:1:1736603001:1.male: I'm fine. It's just... my sword is broken.
say:1:1736603001:1.female: I'm fine. It's just... my sword is broken.

say:2:1736603002:1.text: ... Sorry, I... I know I'm not being clear. My thoughts are a mess right now...
say:2:1736603002:1.source_cn: ……抱歉，我……脑袋有点乱，话说得不太清楚。
say:2:1736603002:1.male: ... Sorry, I... I know I'm not being clear. My thoughts are a mess right now...
say:2:1736603002:1.female: ... Sorry, I... I know I'm not being clear. My thoughts are a mess right now...

choice_prompt:3:1736603002.text: ... Sorry, I... I know I'm not being clear. My thoughts are a mess right now...
choice_prompt:3:1736603002.source_cn: ……抱歉，我……脑袋有点乱，话说得不太清楚。

choice_prompt:3:1736603002.female: ... Sorry, I... I know I'm not being clear. My thoughts are a mess right now...

say:4:1736603003:1.text: ... Thanks for letting me bend your ear... I think I needed to get this off my chest.
say:4:1736603003:1.source_cn: ……谢谢。我是该把那些话和谁说出来……这样或许心里就会...
say:4:1736603003:1.male: ... Thanks for letting me bend your ear... I think I needed to get this off my chest.
say:4:1736603003:1.female: ... Thanks for letting me bend your ear... I think I needed to get this off my chest.

say:5:1736603005:1.text: The sword's been my passion since childhood, yet I was constantly told it wasn't a woman's weapon.
say:5:1736603005:1.source_cn: 从小时候起我就对剑术感兴趣。周围人总说那是男人的武器，...
say:5:1736603005:1.male: The sword's been my passion since childhood, yet I was constantly told it wasn't a woman's weapon.
say:5:1736603005:1.female: The sword's been my passion since childhood, yet I was constantly told it wasn't a woman's weapon.

say:6:1736603006:1.text: I never let their words get to me. Once I pick up my sword, they fall silent.
say:6:1736603006:1.source_cn: 但我举起剑，挥动它时，那些人就全都学会了闭嘴。
say:6:1736603006:1.male: I never let their words get to me. Once I pick up my sword, they fall silent.
say:6:1736603006:1.female: I never let their words get to me. Once I pick up my sword, they fall silent.

say:7:1736603007:1.text: The blacksmith says I've got the makings of a Royal Guard captain. A shame, he reckons, to see such talent wasted on someone from a humble background.
say:7:1736603007:1.source_cn: 铁匠说我有剑术天赋，换成有钱人家的少爷说不定能去守备军...
say:7:1736603007:1.male: The blacksmith says I've got the makings of a Royal Guard captain. A shame, he reckons, to see such talent wasted on someone from a humble background.
say:7:1736603007:1.female: The blacksmith says I've got the makings of a Royal Guard captain. A shame, he reckons, to see such talent wasted on someone from a humble background.

say:8:1736603008:1.text: I don't see things his way. He's making assumptions way too soon.
say:8:1736603008:1.source_cn: 有什么可惜的？我不服。我的就是我的。
say:8:1736603008:1.male: I don't see things his way. He's making assumptions way too soon.
say:8:1736603008:1.female: I don't see things his way. He's making assumptions way too soon.

say:9:1736603009:1.text: So, I've been pushing myself even harder in training to prove him wrong. My parents don't mind, figuring I can keep thugs at bay.
say:9:1736603009:1.source_cn: 那之后我加倍努力练剑。爸妈觉得这样也不错，起码家里不用...
say:9:1736603009:1.male: So, I've been pushing myself even harder in training to prove him wrong. My parents don't mind, figuring I can keep thugs at bay.
say:9:1736603009:1.female: So, I've been pushing myself even harder in training to prove him wrong. My parents don't mind, figuring I can keep thugs at bay.

say:10:1736603010:1.text: But that grates on me. Why should my skill be confined to chasing off petty criminals?
say:10:1736603010:1.source_cn: 听了这话我一点也不高兴，一点也不。我的天赋难道只能用在...
say:10:1736603010:1.male: But that grates on me. Why should my skill be confined to chasing off petty criminals?
say:10:1736603010:1.female: But that grates on me. Why should my skill be confined to chasing off petty criminals?

say:11:1736603011:1.text: They're unworthy opponents! Most scatter the moment I reach for my sword. And when I'm older, I'll probably be drowning in housework with no time to practice.
say:11:1736603011:1.source_cn: 他们胆子小得很，剑还没抽出来不少人就会被吓跑。按爸妈规...
say:11:1736603011:1.male: They're unworthy opponents! Most scatter the moment I reach for my sword. And when I'm older, I'll probably be drowning in housework with no time to practice.
say:11:1736603011:1.female: They're unworthy opponents! Most scatter the moment I reach for my sword. And when I'm older, I'll probably be drowning in housework with no time to practice.

say:12:1736603012:1.text: The blacksmith sees something in me! Joining the Royal Guard isn't just wishful thinking!
say:12:1736603012:1.source_cn: 可铁匠不是说过我的天赋能去当守备军队长吗？为什么我现在...
say:12:1736603012:1.male: The blacksmith sees something in me! Joining the Royal Guard isn't just wishful thinking!
say:12:1736603012:1.female: The blacksmith sees something in me! Joining the Royal Guard isn't just wishful thinking!

say:13:1736603013:1.text: "Only nobles can join the guards." Hmph, I hear it all the time, but I refuse to let it stop me.
say:13:1736603013:1.source_cn: “身份所限”。哼。我又不是没有被这话困住过。但那次我就...
say:13:1736603013:1.male: "Only nobles can join the guards." Hmph, I hear it all the time, but I refuse to let it stop me.
say:13:1736603013:1.female: "Only nobles can join the guards." Hmph, I hear it all the time, but I refuse to let it stop me.

say:14:1736603014:1.text: I've been waiting for my chance to shine, and it's finally here.
say:14:1736603014:1.source_cn: 我想我只是差个机会，拔剑的机会。而前段时间机会来了。
say:14:1736603014:1.male: I've been waiting for my chance to shine, and it's finally here.
say:14:1736603014:1.female: I've been waiting for my chance to shine, and it's finally here.

say:15:1736603015:1.text: The upper district elites are holding a swordsmanship competition. Yes, it's all for their entertainment, but if I perform well...
say:15:1736603015:1.source_cn: 上城区的贵族老爷们计划筹备一场剑术比赛。虽说是取悦贵族...

say:15:1736603015:1.female: The upper district elites are holding a swordsmanship competition. Yes, it's all for their entertainment, but if I perform well...

say:16:1736603016:1.text: ... It'll be my only chance to change my fate.
say:16:1736603016:1.source_cn: ……说实话，我不知道贵族是怎么挑侍卫的。但这是我能想到...
say:16:1736603016:1.male: ... It'll be my only chance to change my fate.
say:16:1736603016:1.female: ... It'll be my only chance to change my fate.

say:17:1736603017:1.text: The problem is, every contestant has to register their own sword, so I can't borrow one. And since it's an event for the rich, they wouldn't expect anyone to show up without one.
say:17:1736603017:1.source_cn: 比赛要登记自己的佩剑，所以借剑行不通。毕竟那是给贵族准...
say:17:1736603017:1.male: The problem is, every contestant has to register their own sword, so I can't borrow one. And since it's an event for the rich, they wouldn't expect anyone to show up without one.
say:17:1736603017:1.female: The problem is, every contestant has to register their own sword, so I can't borrow one. And since it's an event for the rich, they wouldn't expect anyone to show up without one.

say:18:1736603018:1.text: I scraped together every coin I owned to buy this sword, but it's not sturdy enough. I need more money to have it reinforced.

say:18:1736603018:1.male: I scraped together every coin I owned to buy this sword, but it's not sturdy enough. I need more money to have it reinforced.
say:18:1736603018:1.female: I scraped together every coin I owned to buy this sword, but it's not sturdy enough. I need more money to have it reinforced.

say:19:1736603019:1.male: And now it's broken, while I'm still saving up for the cost.
say:19:1736603019:1.female: And now it's broken, while I'm still saving up for the cost.

say:20:1736603020:1.text: The competition is only hours away... Looks like fate has already closed the door on me.
say:20:1736603020:1.source_cn: 或许这就是命运吧。几小时后就要比赛，结果命运先我一步拔剑了。

say:20:1736603020:1.female: The competition is only hours away... Looks like fate has already closed the door on me.

say:21:1736603021:1.source_cn: 没关系。这次不行，还有下次。我可以等，反正……反正……
